persona.name: Dolly — Aggressive Row Filler
persona.description: Prioritizes completing active lyric lines, freeing rows quickly, and using newly available rows to introduce additional playable lines.
persona.strategy: Prefer active lines closest to completion; play every usable word; when opening a row, favor shorter candidate lines.
